title: Model profile catalog configuration schema
description: Validation schema for the conf/model-profiles.conf.yaml catalog. Owns the canonical capability-tag vocabulary (#/definitions/capabilities): the same tag->0-10 map shape scored per model here and weighted per workflow step in conf/workflows/*.workflow.conf.yaml.

modelProfiles.description: Canonical model catalog: capability scores and cost rank per model profile.

modelProfile.description: One model profile: canonical slug, cost rank, optional prose, and scored capabilities.

costRank.description: Relative cost rank (1 = cheapest, 10 = most expensive).

description.description: Human-readable description of the model profile.

note.description: Additional note or caveats for this profile.

capabilities.description: Canonical capability-tag vocabulary: map of capability tag -> number (0-10). Used as scores in the model catalog and as weights on workflow steps.

deep-reasoning.description: Depth and quality of analytical reasoning.

coding.description: Code generation and software engineering capability.

tool-use.description: Reliability and fluency in using external tools.

long-context.description: Ability to retain and reason over long contexts.

multimodal.description: Ability to process and reason over non-text modalities.

writing-quality.description: Quality of prose and structured written output.

instruction-following.description: Adherence to detailed instructions and schemas.
